# Mohamed Senator

> Systems Administrator / Cloud Infrastructure & Automation. Builder of 12 public Apify Actors for AI agents, RAG, SEO, sales intelligence and Saudi real estate data, published at https://apify.com/s3nafps.

Every Actor can be called from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client via https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=s3nafps/<actor-name>. Each Store page also has a Markdown version at https://apify.com/s3nafps/<actor-name>.md.

## Apify Actors

- [Website & HTML to Markdown Crawler for LLMs and RAG](https://apify.com/s3nafps/ai-ready-webpage-extractor.md): Convert web pages, docs sites and blogs to clean Markdown and RAG chunks. Use this when an LLM or agent needs readable page text: JS rendering, sitemap crawl, $3 per 1,000 pages.
- [Company Buying Signals: Hiring, SEC Filings & News](https://apify.com/s3nafps/company-why-now-signals.md): Find why a company is worth contacting now: hiring spikes, SEC filings and news, ranked with dates and source URLs. Use this when a sales agent needs cited reasons to reach out. From $0.03.
- [Domain Security Scanner: SSL, DMARC, Subdomains, Tech Stack](https://apify.com/s3nafps/domain-exposure-intel.md): Passive security report for a domain: SSL/TLS, headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, subdomains, tech stack and known CVEs, scored 0-100 with fixes. Use this when vetting a vendor or your own domain.
- [AI Web Scraper: Webpage to JSON with Source Quotes](https://apify.com/s3nafps/webpage-to-json-for-ai-agents.md): Extract typed JSON from any web page with AI. Describe fields in plain English or JSON Schema; each value has a source quote. Use this when an agent needs structured page data. $0.03/page.
- [Google Trends Scraper & API: Compare 500 Keywords](https://apify.com/s3nafps/google-trends-bulk-compare.md): Compare up to 500 keywords on one Google Trends 0-100 scale, past the 5-term limit, for web, YouTube, News, Images or Shopping. Use this when ranking keyword ideas. $2 per 1,000 keywords.
- [Bilibili Scraper: Videos, Comments, Trending & UP主 Profiles](https://apify.com/s3nafps/bilibili-scraper.md): Scrape Bilibili (B站) without login: video search, details, comments, trending boards and UP主 profiles. Use this when tracking a brand or trend in China. From $2.50 per 1,000 videos.
- [YouTube Transcript Scraper & API: Bulk Captions for AI](https://apify.com/s3nafps/youtube-transcripts-for-ai.md): Get YouTube transcripts and captions in bulk from videos, Shorts, channels, playlists or search as text, Markdown and RAG chunks. Use this when an LLM needs video text. $2 per 1,000.
- [Aqar.fm Monitor: Saudi New Listings & Price Drop Alerts](https://apify.com/s3nafps/aqar-monitor.md): Get only new Aqar.fm listings and price changes for any Saudi property search, in English + Arabic. Use this when you want scheduled daily property alerts. $5 per 1,000 changes reported.
- [PDF & Word to Markdown Converter for RAG (Page Numbers)](https://apify.com/s3nafps/doc-to-markdown.md): Convert PDF and Word (.docx) files from URLs to clean Markdown and RAG chunks with page numbers. Use this when an LLM must read and cite documents. $0.005 per file + $0.001 per page.
- [Aqar.fm Scraper: Saudi Real Estate Listings (EN/AR)](https://apify.com/s3nafps/aqar-scraper.md): Scrape Aqar.fm listings in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam and every Saudi city, in English + Arabic, with price per m², below-market flags and agent licences. Use this when you need Saudi property data.
- [Sitemap Extractor & URL Classifier (Sitemap Parser)](https://apify.com/s3nafps/sitemap-intelligence-api.md): Extract every URL from a site's sitemaps and robots.txt and tag it as pricing, docs, blog, changelog, product, legal or support. Use this when you need a site's page inventory fast.
- [Google Search API: Custom Search JSON API Replacement](https://apify.com/s3nafps/google-custom-search-api.md): Google Search results in Google's Custom Search JSON format (that API ends Jan 1, 2027). Use this when code or an agent needs a drop-in SERP API: same params, $1.50 per 1,000 searches.
